record.dic_text:
04478 man {mawn}

源自 04100; TWOT - 1208,1209; 陽性名詞

AV - manna 14; 14

1) 嗎哪
   1a) 由天上降下的食物, 餵養了以色列人四十年在曠野漂流的日子
   1b) 其意思為 '那是什麼?'
record.edic_text:
04478 man {mawn}

from 04100; TWOT - 1208,1209; n m

AV - manna 14; 14

1) manna
   1a) the bread from Heaven that fed the Israelites for 40 years of
       wilderness wanderings
   1b) means 'What is it?'
